name: chennai-properties-ai
description: ChennaiProperties AI property assistant — local-first prototype

scripts.setup: node -e "const f=require('fs');if(!f.existsSync('.env')){f.copyFileSync('.env.example','.env');console.log('Created .env from .env.example')}" && npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run check:secrets && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
